# Source snapshots

`ec-ip-26-1900.pdf` is the European Commission's public print document captured
on 2026-09-27 from
`https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/api/files/document/print/en/ip_26_1900/IP_26_1900_EN.pdf`.
It tests the actual bounded PDF extractor offline, not an invented text result.
The publisher is the European Commission; the snapshot is evidence for parser
regression only and does not imply permission to fetch other publishers' content.

`tibo-reset-announcements.atom` contains two short records captured on
2026-10-29 from `https://tokenusage.dev/api/resets.atom`. It retains the provider's
rights statement, original post IDs/timestamps and each summary's credit link.
Data: [tokenusage.dev](https://tokenusage.dev/resets). Reuse requires that linked
credit on the same screen or in the same message when displaying records to
others; personal use needs no visible credit. Relays must retain the credit link
and pass on this condition. This fixture contains no original post text and
tests announcement parsing, not account eligibility or reset completion.
